key_patterns: Backend: pg Pool via DATABASE_URL; schema.sql applied at boot (idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS). Helpers productFields (column-list string), normalizeProduct(row) -> camelCase JSON, productValues(body) -> positional insert/update values. Middleware requireAuth sets request.userId (uid only, NOT name/role); requireAdmin reads role from DB. Transaction pattern = pool.connect() + BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK with try/catch/finally client.release(), exactly as in the categories PUT route. Errors flow via next(error) to a single error handler returning 500. Unique-violation = error.code === '23505'. Frontend: fetch(`${API_URL}/...`, { headers: authHeaders() }), API_URL='http://localhost:3001/api', authHeaders() adds Bearer token from localStorage('lumina-token'). State in a single App() component with activeView sidebar nav ('products' | 'categories' | 'users' | 'profile'); admin-only views gated by isAdmin (currentUser.role==='admin'). pushToast(type,message) for notifications. formatIDR for currency. lucide-react icons. CSV export via exportCsv (currently header Name,Category,Price,Stock,Status). The app has a local-mode fallback (seedProducts) when the API is offline.
